defects_found_and_fixed_during_live_veri.summary: PreToolUse decided which paths a Bash command writes to by matching raw text, so quoted text and heredoc bodies were read as writes, and `sed -i` captured the sed script instead of the file operand
defects_found_and_fixed_during_live_veri.impact: over-blocked harmless read-only commands, and allowed `sed -i` to rewrite .claude/hooks/gate.py, .claude/settings.json and pinned upstream paths outside a freeze

defects_found_and_fixed_during_live_veri.summary: handle_config_change read `config_source`, but live payloads name the field `source`, so every real change resolved to 'unknown' and fell through to allow
defects_found_and_fixed_during_live_veri.impact: the ConfigChange gate could not block anything in live operation; invisible to the static suite, whose helper built the synthetic spelling

external_blocker.blocker: Claude Code 2.1.220 running headless in this remote execution environment does not emit the TeammateIdle hook event for Agent-tool teammates that go idle owing assigned work
external_blocker.evidence: five genuine idles by named teammates owning an in_progress task with a missing required artifact produced zero TeammateIdle invocations; a dedicated diagnostic hook registered on the event captured nothing while provably working (it captured ConfigChange payloads and passed a self-test), and the gate registered on the same event never blocked any teammate
ruled_out: registration: both hooks are listed under TeammateIdle in .claude/settings.json
agent teams disabled: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is set and reaches the process environment
version drift: the running version 2.1.220 is exactly the version .claude/HOOKS_README.md claims the contract was verified against
alternatives_attempted: named Agent-tool teammate with a TASK_GRAPH.json contract naming it owner
resumed the teammate via SendMessage and instructed a clean idle with no trailing tool call, twice
assigned a tracked Claude Code task to the teammate and left it in_progress
a second teammate with a one-line instruction that used zero tools and idled in 4.5 seconds
verified hook registration, diagnostic-hook operation, the agent-teams env var, and the Claude Code version
external_blocker.exact_human_action_required: From an interactive Claude Code session with agent teams / FleetView on commit 190b04e, give a teammate a TASK_GRAPH.json task naming it owner with a required_artifacts entry that does not exist, let it go idle, and confirm the gate blocks it with "BLOCKED: teammate '<name>' going idle with outstanding assigned work"; then create the artifact and confirm it may idle. If it blocks then allows, set live_checks.TeammateIdle and live_event_tests to PASS, overall to PASS, and RUN_STATE.json to mode ready_for_master / status READY. If it does not fire there either, treat TeammateIdle as unavailable and correct .claude/HOOKS_README.md sections 1 and 2, because the control plane currently documents a guarantee it does not deliver.

notes: verified_commit is the commit whose hook configuration was live-verified; the commit that records this file is necessarily a later one, so its receipts read as STALE at info severity by design
live evidence was taken from Claude Code's own hook telemetry (system/hook_started and system/hook_response records in --output-format stream-json), not from any model's account of being blocked
no evidence from a pre-fix configuration is counted: live verification was restarted from the beginning after each of the two fixes
a first SubagentStop attempt was discarded because the subagent invoked gate.py directly with a synthetic event instead of being intercepted; the check was redone against host telemetry
